name: statusline-pace
description: The subscription pace above the prompt: the model and ctx on line 1, then aligned 5h/1d/7d/1mo rows for Claude, Fable, Go, z.ai, OpenRouter and Gemini.

showModel.title: Show the model
showModel.description: Show line 1: the model and effort (Opus high).

showContext.title: Show context fill
showContext.description: Show the context window fill (ctx 34%) on line 1.

stateFile.title: Plan state file
stateFile.description: Path to a windows.json for the Fable, Go, z.ai, OpenRouter and Gemini rows (plans.<plan>) and the Claude fallback (plans.claude or subscription); ~ allowed. Empty = off.

oauthUsage.title: Read the subscription usage endpoint
oauthUsage.description: Every 5 minutes, ask api.anthropic.com/api/oauth/usage (the data /usage shows) for the Claude 5h/7d windows and the per-model weekly limits (Fable). Claude Code sends its own login; the plugin never sees the token. Off = engine rate limits and the windows file only.
